title: OpenAI Criticized! Build Your Own Local AI Stack #shorts
description: OpenAI, founded on 'openness,' faces public jokes about renaming to 'Closed AI.' Their own strategic futures head criticized open-weight models, sparking irony. The debate intensifies. #OpenAI #AIethics #TechNews #ArtificialIntelligence
transcript: OpenAI, founded on 'openness,' faces public jokes about renaming to 'Closed AI.' Their own strategic futures head criticized open-weight models, sparking irony. The debate intensifies. #OpenAI #AIethics #TechNews #ArtificialIntelligence

top_comments.author: @JordanJordi-d4d
top_comments.text: The open in OpenAI stopped meaning anything a while ago. I run open-weight models locally for this reason. You control your own configs. No silent degradation, no blanket consumer classifiers.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Exactly — “OpenAI” is mostly branding now 😅 Running open-weight models locally puts you back in the driver’s seat: your configs, your data, no surprise throttling or mystery classifiers. The tradeoff is you’re also on the hook for safety and keeping it running. What’s been the biggest win for you going local — control, cost, or privacy?
